title: Reviewed teaching assets and authorized retrieval
goal: Find eligible teaching material for the actual learning problem.
rationale: Topic similarity alone does not establish teaching suitability or permission to reuse content.
scope: Initial unimplemented draft. Reviewed homework/speaking exercises and explanations. Application-owned search construction from selected objectives, controlled embedding text, separate authorization/eligibility filters and explicit candidate/gap/failure outcomes. Direct private evidence loading and metrics stay separate. Sources: PD-13/15/16/28/33 and Architecture section 6. LLM query rewriting, autonomous search loops and ranking/index tuning are deferred.

depends_on.reason: Uses the authenticated tutor and learner-evidence ownership boundary.

requirement.title: Reviewed teaching assets and authorized retrieval
requirement.statement: Retrieve permissioned, reviewed material by target subskill/confusion, level and task needs, with source/version references. Apply access and license restrictions before ranking; never turn private transcripts into shared teaching assets or invent missing exercise references. The application constructs a controlled teaching-search description and separate filters from a selected structured objective, calls the embedding model and executes the authorized database search. Initial search construction uses no chat-model rewriting or autonomous search loop; model suggestions cannot supply authorization or relax hard constraints. Learner-record loading and metric calculation are separate operations.

scenarios.given: Eligible reviewed material matches the target confusion and level.
scenarios.then: Candidates include suitable material and its source/version, rather than merely a preferred-topic match.
scenarios.verification: Future retrieval observation against a small reviewed fixture bank.

scenarios.given: The only apparent matches are unauthorized, unreviewed or unavailable.
scenarios.then: Those items are not returned as eligible; the content gap remains explicit.
scenarios.verification: Future retrieval eligibility and no-match cases.

scenarios.given: A selected contrastive-choice objective has level/task/domain constraints and evidence references; private learner text and untrusted model-supplied scope are also present in the surrounding context.
scenarios.when: The worker constructs and executes its teaching-material search.
scenarios.then: Application code builds a non-sensitive description preserving the teaching distinction and separate validated filters; authenticated server context owns scope. Private learner text stays out of the embedding input, and initial query construction makes no chat-model call. Return eligible asset IDs/versions and provenance for suitability checks; topic similarity cannot override hard constraints. Invalid search fields are rejected before provider use.
scenarios.verification: Future search-construction and actual provider/database-boundary checks with fixed objectives, private canaries, scope manipulation, malformed fields and call counts.

scenarios.given: The embedding provider or database fails during an otherwise valid material search.
scenarios.when: The worker handles the retrieval outcome.
scenarios.then: Report a preparation failure rather than an empty-bank/content-gap result; no invented vector, candidate reference or ready material is produced.
scenarios.verification: Future injected provider/database failures contrasted with a successful search returning no eligible candidates.

tasks.description: Store reviewed asset versions and their ownership/license metadata.
Build and check controlled descriptions/filters from selected objectives, then connect authorized candidate retrieval with provenance, honest gaps and distinct provider failures.
